text: For twenty years, a dead man kept a diary about me.
The torch was still on when I reached the lamp post.
No one there. Just Mick's old torch, tied to the post.
Pointed at my window.
And under it, a key. Back door.
Mick's house smelt of wolfsbane.
Twenty notebooks on the shelf. One for every year.
Every full moon, the same line.
My initial. At the window. Held.
I found the summer we were ten.
The night I went missing.
He'd written it one-handed.
It wasn't my initial.
It was Danny's.
Danny told me it was me.
There was one more page. The night Mick died.
If I go, keep Danny away from the boy.
Mick wasn't keeping me in.
He was keeping Danny out.
He has a key.
